The `!strip` option is set, which is acceptable for binary packages where stripping debug symbols might not be desired or could break the binary. No executable code or build instructions are present in this file — it only contains declarative packaging metadata.

All sources are from the official and expected GitHub release page of the project, and the checksums are specified, reducing the risk of supply chain tampering. There is no evidence of malicious behavior, unexpected network operations, or unsafe build practices in this file.
</details>
